title: Fire Safety Rules & Early Transit Approved
summary:
*   **New Fire Safety Rules Passed:** Austin amended its fire ordinance, requiring permits from the Fire Department to burn combustible materials or light fires in most public and private places.
*   **Early Transportation Permit Issued:** Ernest Bargaley received approval to operate a "service car," an early form of public transport or taxi.
*   **Charity Staff Wages Reviewed:** A committee from United Charities addressed the council to request an increase in the salary of their Assistant Secretary.

The ordinance was read the first time, and upon motion of Councilman Alford that the rule
be suspended and the ordinance be placed on its second reading; said motion prevailed by
the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward; nays,

The ordinance was then read the second time and Councilman Alford moved a further

passage. Motion carried by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Alford,

The monthly reports of Miss Nellie Hall, Secretary of the United
Charities, were read and ordered filed.

The Council then recessed.
